start: Live workout, Bench Press card, default rest 2:00

steps.action: Tap the card's rest and pick 2:30
user_sees: Rest picker sheet with times and 'Custom rest'

start: Last Squat workout had the note 'belt on top set'

steps.action: Add Squat to a new workout
user_sees: The note 'belt on top set' on the card
must_not: A note from an older workout

user_sees: Pop-up 'New record · Bench Press' naming the record beaten
must_not: A pop-up for a set that beat nothing

start: A past workout opened to correct it; rest picker

steps.action: Change the rest length while correcting
user_sees: The new rest in that workout only
must_not: The length remembered for next time from a correction

start: Squat with a carried note and old bests

steps.action: Clear the note in today's workout and finish
user_sees: Next Squat workout has no carried note

steps.action: Exercise page menu, 'Start records fresh?' then 'Start fresh'
user_sees: Records count from today's workouts on; History keeps every workout
must_not: A record pop-up for a set that only beats pre-reset bests wrongly missing, or old bests still used

start: Member in a gym with a trainer

steps.action: Leave a note on a set, then open Settings > Your gym > What my gym can see
user_sees: Words that notes are never sent
must_not: The note in the trainer summary or anything the gym sees
